name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Kutt URL shortener backed by PostgreSQL for data and Redis for caching and the stats queue, suited to busier instances.

alerts.message: Open the site right after deployment: the first visitor is asked to create the admin account. Public sign-up is off by default; the admin can add users from the admin page. Password reset, email verification and public sign-up need SMTP: set MAIL_ENABLED=true and the MAIL_* variables (and DISALLOW_REGISTRATION=false for sign-up).
